answer: If you smell gas, do not switch any lights or electrical appliances on or off, and do not use a lighter or match. Turn the red gas shut-off lever under the kitchen sink a quarter turn so it is across the pipe. Open windows and the balcony door. Leave the apartment and call the security desk and the emergency maintenance line from outside. Do not go back inside until Rafiq or the security team says it is safe.
